stops.title: Two Turtledoves from Bethlehem

stops.imageCaption: Golden morning limestone hills between Bethlehem and Jerusalem as a humble young family carries a swaddled infant and two white doves.

stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Leviticus 12:8 expressly allowed families who could not afford a lamb to offer two birds—quietly revealing to us the real, humble poverty of the Holy Family.

stops.whatYouCanSeeToday: Archaeologists have uncovered the original 1st-century limestone Southern Steps of the Temple—the exact broad stone stairs Mary, Joseph, and Jesus ascended on Candlemas!

detectiveClues.clueText: While stranded on a becalmed sailing ship off Sicily at age thirty-two and desperately homesick, Newman wrote his immortal hymn "Lead, Kindly Light"—"One step enough for me."

detectiveClues.headline: Voice of the Dreaming Spires

stops.title: The Rainy Night at Littlemore

stops.title: “You Are Peter, and on This Rock...”
stops.subtitle: Sweep your lantern across Caesarea Philippi to uncover 3 hidden memories
stops.imageCaption: Towering reddish-gold cliff face above crystal rushing mountain springs at the foot of Mount Hermon.
stops.whatYouCanSeeToday: Standing beside the rushing Banias springs beneath that towering cliff wall, pilgrims immediately see the vivid landscape Jesus pointed to when speaking of Rock and Gates!
stops.didYouKnowHighlight: In Jesus’s spoken Aramaic, there was zero wordplay difference—both the name and the rock were literally the exact same word: "Kepha" ("You are Kepha, and on this kepha I will build my Church")!
stops.saintQuote: You are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my Church.

hiddenArtifacts.foundTitle: “You Are Peter, and on This Rock...”
hiddenArtifacts.storyUnlocked: Leading His disciples right up to the massive sheer rock cliff of Caesarea Philippi—where pagan shrines called a dark cavern "the Gates of Hades"—Jesus asked: "Who do you say that I am?" Simon spoke out boldly: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God!" Jesus renamed him Kepha (Peter, "Rock"), promising: "On this rock I will build my Church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it."

stops.title: Bernini’s Golden Cathedra Petri
stops.subtitle: Sweep your lantern across Cathedra Petri to uncover 3 hidden memories
stops.imageCaption: Radiant alabaster dove window spilling golden amber sunbeams over Bernini’s bronze clouds and sculpted teaching chair inside St. Peter’s.
stops.whatYouCanSeeToday: On February 22, St. Peter’s Basilica glows with dozens of extra candles illuminating Bernini’s golden Cathedra Petri as pilgrims pray for the unity of Christians worldwide.
stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Notice Bernini’s hidden message of Christian unity: the Chair of Peter is held up equally by TWO Latin Western Church Fathers AND TWO Greek Eastern Church Fathers!
stops.saintQuote: Strengthen your brothers.

hiddenArtifacts.riddleToFind: Find the luminous focal point of Cathedra Petri in the scene.
hiddenArtifacts.hintDirection: Scan the center-left horizon of the painting.

hiddenArtifacts.storyUnlocked: Growing up handsome, hilarious, and obsessed with fancy tailored suits, theater, hunting, and ballroom dancing, eighteen-year-old Francesco was nicknamed "the Dandy of Spoleto." stops.title: Sanctuary Beneath Snow-Crowned Gran Sasso
stops.subtitle: Sweep your lantern across Isola del Gran Sasso to uncover 3 hidden memories
stops.imageCaption: Dramatic snow-capped Apennine peaks of Gran Sasso towering above a serene stone mountain sanctuary glowing at sunset.

stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Every March, up to 10,000 Italian high school students swarm St. Gabriel’s shrine waving their pens in the air to be blessed before their national graduation exams!
